# Crossplane XRD + Composition: `XBuckets` scenario

Two files: the **XRD** (defines the API) and the **Composition** (function-patch-and-transform) using `provider-aws` resources, plus a **Claim** example.

---

## 1. XRD — `definition.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xappstacks.demo.example.com
spec:
  group: demo.example.com
  names:
    kind: XAppStack
    plural: xappstacks
  claimNames:
    kind: AppStack
    plural: appstacks
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              region:
                type: string
                description: AWS region for all resources.
                default: us-east-1
              deletionProtection:
                type: boolean
                description: RDS deletion protection.
                default: true
              backupRetentionDays:
                type: integer
                minimum: 7
                description: RDS backup retention (must be >= 7 per policy).
                default: 7
              dbInstanceClass:
                type: string
                default: db.t3.micro
              dbMultiAZ:
                type: boolean
                default: false
              oidcProviderArn:
                type: string
                description: ARN of the EKS OIDC provider for IAM role trust.
              serviceAccountNamespace:
                type: string
                default: app
              serviceAccountName:
                type: string
                default: app-sa
              bucketNamePrefix:
                type: string
                default: app-assets
            required:
            - region
            - oidcProviderArn
```

---

## 2. Composition — `composition.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xappstacks.demo.example.com
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: demo.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: XAppStack
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
  - step: render-resources
    functionRef:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      resources:

      # ---------- S3 Bucket ----------
      - name: bucket
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Bucket
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              forceDestroy: false
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketNamePrefix
          toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[pt.fn.crossplane.io/append-suffix]
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Format
              fmt: "%s-{{ .composite.resource.metadata.uid }}"

      # Bucket versioning
      - name: bucket-versioning
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketVersioning
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              bucketSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              versioningConfiguration:
                - status: Enabled
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

      # Bucket SSE (AES-256)
      - name: bucket-encryption
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              bucketSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              rule:
                - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                    - sseAlgorithm: AES256
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

      # Block all public access
      - name: bucket-public-access-block
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              bucketSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

      # ---------- RDS PostgreSQL ----------
      - name: db-subnet-group
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: DBSubnetGroup
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              subnetIdRefs: []   # set via EnvironmentConfig or patch from claim in real deploys
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

      - name: db-instance
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Instance
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              engine: postgres
              engineVersion: "15"
              instanceClass: db.t3.micro
              allocatedStorage: 20
              dbSubnetGroupNameSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              deletionProtection: true
              backupRetentionPeriod: 7
              publiclyAccessible: false
              skipFinalSnapshot: false
              finalSnapshotIdentifier: app-db-final
              autoGeneratePassword: true
              username: appadmin
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbInstanceClass
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.deletionProtection
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.deletionProtection
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.backupRetentionDays
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbMultiAZ
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
        - type: ToCompositeStatus
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
          toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint

      # ---------- IAM Role for Service Account (IRSA) ----------
      - name: iam-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          spec:
            forProvider:
              assumeRolePolicy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Principal": {"AWS": "*"},
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
                    "Condition": {
                      "StringEquals": {
                        "${OIDC_PROVIDER}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:NS:SA",
                        "${OIDC_PROVIDER}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                      }
                    }
                  }]
                }
        patches:
        # Build OIDC provider host from ARN, e.g. arn:aws:iam::123:oidc-provider/oidc.eks... -> oidc.eks...
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.oidcProviderArn
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                group: 1
                pattern: '.*oidc-provider/(.*)'
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Format
              fmt: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Principal": {" Federated": "PLACEHOLDER_ARN" },
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                    "Condition": {
                      "StringEquals": {
                        "https://%s:sub": "system:serviceaccount:{{ .composite.resource.spec.serviceAccountNamespace }}:{{ .composite.resource.spec.serviceAccountName }}",
                        "https://%s:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                      }
                    }
                  }]
                }
        # Fix the Federated principal back to the full ARN
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: spec.oidcProviderArn
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                pattern: 'PLACEHOLDER_ARN'
                group: 1
        - type: ToCompositeStatus
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
          toFieldPath: status.roleArn

      # Least-privilege role policy: S3 access to assets bucket only
      - name: iam-role-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicy
          spec:
            forProvider:
              roleSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              policy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
                      "Resource": "*"
                    }
                  ]
                }
        patches:
        # Scope the policy to the provisioned bucket only (no wildcards beyond object paths)
        - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
          fromFieldPath: metadata.uid   # replaced below via bucket ARN in status
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                pattern: '.*'
                group: 0
        - type: CombineFromComposite
          combine:
            variables:
            - fromFieldPath: status.bucketArn
            strategy: string
            string:
              fmt: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
                    "Resource": "%s/*"
                  }, {
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
                    "Resource": "%s"
                  }]
                }
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy

  # Bucket ARN surfaced to composite status for policy scoping
  # (add a ToCompositeStatus patch on the bucket resource):
  # - type: ToCompositeStatus
  #   fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
  #   toFieldPath: status.bucketArn
```

> Add the commented `ToCompositeStatus` patch on the `bucket` resource to expose `status.bucketArn` used by `iam-role-policy`.

---

## 3. Claim — `dev-claim.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: demo.example.com/v1alpha1
kind: AppStack
metadata:
  name: app-dev
  namespace: dev
spec:
  region: us-east-1
  dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
  dbMultiAZ: false
  deletionProtection: true
  backupRetentionDays: 7
  bucketNamePrefix: app-dev-assets
  oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE
  serviceAccountNamespace: app
  serviceAccountName: app-sa
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-dev
```

---

## Notes on acceptance-criteria mapping

| Criterion | How met |
|---|---|
| Bucket versioning + SSE + no public access | `BucketVersioning`, `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` (AES-256), `BucketPublicAccessBlock` (all four blocks) |
| RDS deletion protection, backup ≥ 7 days, not public | `deletionProtection: true`, schema `minimum: 7` enforced at API level, `publiclyAccessible: false`, final snapshot |
| IAM least privilege | Policy scoped via `CombineFromComposite` to the created bucket ARN only — no wildcard actions |
| Env isolation | Separate claims per namespace + separate `providerConfigRef` per environment (dev/prod), prod claim just changes parameters (multiAZ, `db.t3.medium`, cross-region replication can be added as an additional conditional `BucketReplicationConfiguration` resource) |

Deployment: `kubectl apply -f definition.yaml -f composition.yaml` (with `function-patch-and-transform` installed in the cluster), then apply the claim.
